description: Works out which of four stored limits applies, and only when the input has reached that limit it stores the slot number and record fields, sets the request flag and clears the busy flag. Otherwise it just clears the busy flag.

name: set_flag_by_index

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:09AA
name: store_registers_to_record
description: Sets a record's first word to one, copies four data registers and an address register into the following fields, and zeroes the last word. It saves a request's parameters into a block.

description: Clears the record's completion word and checks the busy flag for the audio channel named in the record. If that channel is free it writes the record's two values to its period and volume hardware registers; otherwise it clears the record's status fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:09CE

description: Advances one channel's sound sequence. When the step counter runs out it reads the next sequence command and applies it, with a zero command value ending the sequence. Otherwise it counts the step down and applies a ramp to the level and period, then stores the output value in the channel record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:149E

It copies the first word as the current value, sets the step counter and pointer fields, clears a status word and stores the first output value in the channel record. A zero first word ends the start.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:14EE

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:1574
name: read_channel_command_and_apply
description: Fetches the next command for a channel from its current sequence pointer or its fallback pointer, depending on a counter. A zero command ends the sequence. Otherwise it sets the channel's period and step fields, updates pointers and flags, and stores the output value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:1586

description: Loads a channel's sequence state from a pointer block. A zero first word copies start values into the channel record, otherwise four words of state are stored. It then applies the block's command as the other sequencer routines do and stores the output value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:15DC

description: Chooses the next sequence block for a channel from a list pointer, advancing the list when its entry is zero. It reads the block's command, applies it as the other sequencer routines do, and stores the output value. A zero command ends the update.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:15F6

description: Stores a long value from a pointer into the channel record and advances the record's pointer to the next entry. It then reads the block's command, applies it as the other sequencer routines do, and stores the output value. A zero command ends the update.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:1604
name: load_sequence_header_and_apply

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:1610

name: clear_status_apply_sequence
